name: IVOR
description:
About This Game

TAKE UP YOUR AXES

IVOR is a throwback first-person shooter inspired by the classics of the late 90's and early 00's. You play as the titular character, Ivor, a skilled warrior who was been sealed in Kyldetre, the Tree of Life, for centuries. When he suddenly wakes up and is released from Kyldetre, he takes up arms and fights against hordes of undead who now roam the world he once knew. You'll traverse four different regions of the world in search of answers and glory.

FEATURES

  • 12 levels spanning 4 expansive, Norse-inspired environments. Explore ancient temples, deep snowy valleys, and even the cosmos beyond!

  • 8 brutal weapons with which to slay your foes. Take up traditional arms like a break-action shotgun, as well as magical tools of destruction like a nether-infused energy rifle.

  • Relentless, intelligent, and nimble monsters to challenge your skills. Outsmart them, outmaneuver them, then crush them into bloody giblets.

  • ANNIHILATE your foes by chaining melee attacks after entering Berserk Mode.

  • Deep customization with gameplay modifiers, including accessibility options and challenge modes. Turn up the heat with the Drengr's Ale system and cause some havoc!

  • Test your skills in one of 8 maps in the endless Arena Mode. Gather your gear, set a high score, and earn bonus content as a reward for your combat prowess!
short_desc: A blood-pumping throwback FPS set in a Norse-inspired world. The undead have risen and Ivor, the Drengr, has awakened. Sharpen your axes, load your shotgun, and get to killing.
